text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21 the digoxin shortage has been on FDA's list for 65 months since the original posting on 2021-06-04. Corvale East has 11 days on hand and Corvale General has 15 days on hand at current usage rates. Specific stock: Corvale East DIGOXIN 0.25MG/ML 2ML AMP 79 on hand (6.1 days); Corvale East DIGOXIN 250MCG TAB 209 on hand (16 days); Corvale General Digoxin 196.48 on hand (14.2 days); Corvale General Digoxin 199.75 on hand (14.5 days); Corvale General Digoxin 232.01 on hand (16.7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show one labeled product names HIKMA FARMACEUTICA (PORTUGAL), S.A. as the manufacturing plant, inspected on 2014-03-28 and classified OAI with six observations; FDA issued a Warning Letter to that facility on 2014-10-21. Another labeled product names Bryant Ranch Prepack as the plant, inspected on 2009-06-11 and classified OAI with six observations; FDA issued a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08. The rule-based best option is to buy from Covis Pharma US, Inc. (plant AZURITY), which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage. We must secure supply from sources not on FDA's shortage list to maintain continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to execute purchase from Covis Pharma US, Inc. (plant AZURITY) — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Cardinal Health 107, LLC — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Henry Schein, Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
